behaviour: Preserve multi-page viewports and normalize orphaned element pageIds when loading .excalidraw files from blobs.
rules: 1. In loadSceneOrLibraryFromBlob, restore appState first via restoreAppState (only spreading getScrollToContentState when !Array.isArray(data.appState?.pages) || data.appState.pages.length === 0), and then call restoreElements with validPageIds: appState.pages.map((p) => p.id) and defaultPageId: appState.pages[0]?.id.

sites.rule: Restore appState and elements with validPageIds and defaultPageId, applying getScrollToContentState only for legacy single-page payloads without pages.

behaviour: Pass the full multi-page elements map into history.undo and history.redo and return replaceAllPages: true so undo/redo on the active page preserves other pages' elements in Store and Scene.
rules: 1. In executeHistoryAction, include replaceAllPages: true in the returned ActionResult when result is non-empty.

2. In createUndoAction.perform and createRedoAction.perform, pass app.scene.getAllElementsMapIncludingDeleted() as SceneElementsMap (falling back to arrayToMap(elements) as SceneElementsMap if unavailable) to history.undo and history.redo.

sites.rule: Add replaceAllPages: true to the ActionResult returned by executeHistoryAction.
Pass app.scene.getAllElementsMapIncludingDeleted() as SceneElementsMap to history.undo.
Pass app.scene.getAllElementsMapIncludingDeleted() as SceneElementsMap to history.redo.

behaviour: Include all pages' elements when saving to .excalidraw files and replace all pages when loading a scene from a file.
rules: 1. In actionSaveToActiveFile and actionSaveFileToDisk, pass app.scene.getAllElementsIncludingDeleted() instead of active-page elements to prepareDataForJSONExport.
2. In actionLoadScene, pass app.scene.getAllElementsIncludingDeleted() to loadFromJSON and return replaceAllPages: true in the ActionResult.

sites.rule: Pass app.scene.getAllElementsIncludingDeleted() to prepareDataForJSONExport in actionSaveToActiveFile.
Pass app.scene.getAllElementsIncludingDeleted() to prepareDataForJSONExport in actionSaveFileToDisk.
Pass app.scene.getAllElementsIncludingDeleted() to loadFromJSON and include replaceAllPages: true in the returned ActionResult.

behaviour: Style the page tab bar, active tab highlight, inline rename input, reorder/delete action buttons, and add-page button across light and dark themes.
rules: 1. Scope styles under .excalidraw .page-tab-bar with pointer-events: var(--ui-pointer-events), horizontal flex layout, overflow-x: auto, rounded border, and theme-aware surface colors.

2. Style .page-tab-bar__tab and .page-tab-bar__tab--active with clear visual distinction for the active page tab, compact action buttons (.page-tab-bar__action-btn), inline rename input (.page-tab-bar__rename-input), and add button (.page-tab-bar__add-btn).

sites.rule: Scope styles under .excalidraw .page-tab-bar.

behaviour: Render the interactive page tab bar allowing users to view ordered pages, switch pages, create pages, rename pages inline, reorder pages, and delete pages.
rules: 1. Export PageTabBar component accepting { appState: UIAppState; actionManager: ActionManager }.

2. Render a container <div className={clsx("page-tab-bar", "zen-mode-transition", { "layer-ui__wrapper__footer-left--transition-bottom": appState.zenModeEnabled })} data-testid="page-tab-bar" role="tablist" aria-label={t("pages.title")}>.

3. For each page in appState.pages (with index), render a tab wrapper containing: (a) when renamingPageId === page.id and !appState.viewModeEnabled, an <input data-testid="page-rename-input" className="page-tab-bar__rename-input" aria-label={t("pages.pageName")} ... /> that commits via actionManager.executeAction(actionRenamePage, "ui", { id: page.id, name: draftName }) on Enter or blur and cancels without renaming on Escape; (b) otherwise a <button type="button" role="tab" aria-selected={isActive} data-testid={`page-tab-${page.id}`} className={clsx("page-tab-bar__tab", { "page-tab-bar__tab--active": isActive })} onClick={() => actionManager.executeAction(actionSwitchPage, "ui", page.id)} onDoubleClick={() => !appState.viewModeEnabled && startRenaming(page)}>{page.name}</button>.

4. When !appState.viewModeEnabled, render per-tab control buttons for the active tab (or on each tab): rename trigger <button type="button" data-testid={`page-rename-${page.id}`} aria-label={t("pages.renamePage")} onClick={() => startRenaming(page)} />, move-left <button type="button" data-testid={`page-move-left-${page.id}`} aria-label={t("pages.moveLeft")} disabled={index === 0} onClick={() => actionManager.executeAction(actionReorderPages, "ui", { fromIndex: index, toIndex: index - 1 })} />, move-right <button type="button" data-testid={`page-move-right-${page.id}`} aria-label={t("pages.moveRight")} disabled={index === appState.pages.length - 1} onClick={() => actionManager.executeAction(actionReorderPages, "ui", { fromIndex: index, toIndex: index + 1 })} />, and delete <button type="button" data-testid={`page-delete-${page.id}`} aria-label={t("pages.deletePage")} disabled={appState.pages.length <= 1} onClick={() => actionManager.executeAction(actionDeletePage, "ui", page.id)} />.

5. When !appState.viewModeEnabled, render the add-page button <button type="button" className="page-tab-bar__add-btn" data-testid="page-add-button" aria-label={t("pages.addPage")} title={t("pages.addPage")} onClick={() => actionManager.executeAction(actionCreatePage, "ui")}>+</button>.

sites.rule: Export PageTabBar component accepting { appState: UIAppState; actionManager: ActionManager }.

behaviour: Render PageTabBar inside the desktop Footer when defaultUIEnabled is true without modifying FooterCenterTunnel.Out.
rules: 1. Import { PageTabBar } from "../PageTabBar".

2. Inside <footer ...>, render {defaultUIEnabled && <PageTabBar appState={appState} actionManager={actionManager} />} right before <FooterCenterTunnel.Out /> so .footer-center children remain unchanged.

sites.rule: Import { PageTabBar } from "../PageTabBar".
Render {defaultUIEnabled && <PageTabBar appState={appState} actionManager={actionManager} />} before <FooterCenterTunnel.Out />.

behaviour: Pass all pages' non-deleted elements to JSONExportDialog so exporting to .excalidraw file or shareable link from the export dialog includes all pages.
rules: 1. In renderJSONExportDialog, pass elements={app.scene.getAllNonDeletedElements()} to <JSONExportDialog />.

sites.rule: Pass elements={app.scene.getAllNonDeletedElements()} to JSONExportDialog.

behaviour: Search non-deleted text and frame elements across all pages, display page name on results, and switch to the matched element's page on selection.
rules: 1. Import getElementPageId from @excalidraw/element and actionSwitchPage from ../actions.
2. Add pageId: string and pageName: string to SearchMatchItem.

3. In SearchMenu, observe allElements = app.scene.getAllNonDeletedElements() in the search useEffect dependency list so changes on any page re-run search; in goToNextItem and goToPreviousItem treat focusIndex === null || focusIndex < 0 as starting at index 0.

4. In the focusIndex navigation useEffect, when match is present and getElementPageId(match.element) !== app.state.activePageId, call app.actionManager.executeAction(actionSwitchPage, "ui", getElementPageId(match.element)) before checking viewport visibility and calling app.viewport.setViewport.
5. Pass pageName={app.state.pages.length > 1 ? searchMatch.pageName : undefined} to ListItem and render a {props.pageName} inside ListItem when props.pageName is defined.

6. In handleSearch, read const elements = app.scene.getAllNonDeletedElements(), resolve each element's pageId via getElementPageId(el) and pageName from app.state.pages.find((p) => p.id === pageId)?.name ?? app.state.pages[0]?.name ?? "", attach pageId and pageName to each SearchMatchItem, and set initial focusIndex to the first visible match on the active page (or 0 when matchItems.length > 0 and none are currently in visibleIds, else null).

sites.rule: Import getElementPageId from @excalidraw/element and actionSwitchPage from ../actions.
Add pageId: string; and pageName: string; to SearchMatchItem.
Read allElements = app.scene.getAllNonDeletedElements() alongside elementsMap.
Include allElements in search useEffect dependencies and handle focusIndex < 0 in goToNextItem and goToPreviousItem.
If getElementPageId(match.element) !== app.state.activePageId, execute actionSwitchPage with getElementPageId(match.element) before computing viewport bounds.
Accept optional pageName?: string on ListItem and render {props.pageName} when present.
Pass pageName={searchMatch.pageName} to ListItem in MatchListBase.
Use app.scene.getAllNonDeletedElements() in handleSearch, populate pageId and pageName on each match, and compute focusIndex safely.

behaviour: Wire Scene and History activePageId synchronization, multi-page Store commits and onChange emissions (without mutating pages on every scroll/zoom), multi-page initializeScene/resetScene/updateScene/loadFileToCanvas, and full-scene getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted.
rules: 1. In getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted and getSceneElementsMapIncludingDeleted, return this.scene.getAllElementsIncludingDeleted() and this.scene.getAllElementsMapIncludingDeleted() so host apps, storage, and collab receive all pages' elements while getSceneElements() continues returning active-page non-deleted elements.

2. In syncActionResult, if typeof actionResult.appState?.activePageId === "string", call this.scene.setActivePageId(actionResult.appState.activePageId, { informMutation: false }) and this.history.setActivePageId(actionResult.appState.activePageId); when actionResult.elements is present, call this.scene.replaceAllElements(actionResult.elements, { replaceAllPages: Boolean(actionResult.replaceAllPages || actionResult.replaceFiles || (actionResult.appState && "pages" in actionResult.appState)) }).

3. In resetScene, read const defaultAppState = getDefaultAppState(); call this.scene.setActivePageId(defaultAppState.activePageId, { informMutation: false }), this.history.setActivePageId(defaultAppState.activePageId), and this.scene.replaceAllElements([], { replaceAllPages: true }).

4. In initializeScene, call let restoredAppState = restoreAppState(initialData?.appState, null); before restoreElements, then call restoreElements(initialData?.elements, null, { repairBindings: true, deleteInvisibleElements: true, validPageIds: restoredAppState.pages.map((p) => p.id), defaultPageId: restoredAppState.pages[0]?.id }).

5. In componentDidUpdate, pass this.scene.getAllElementsMapIncludingDeleted() to this.store.commit and pass this.scene.getAllElementsIncludingDeleted() to this.props.onChange and this.onChangeEmitter.trigger; do NOT update this.state.pages or call setState on scroll or zoom in componentDidUpdate (scrollX, scrollY, and zoom are saved into the page entry only when leaving a page or exporting).

6. In updateScene, when appState && "activePageId" in appState && typeof appState.activePageId === "string", call this.scene.setActivePageId(appState.activePageId, { informMutation: false }) and this.history.setActivePageId(appState.activePageId) before this.setState; when elements is provided, call this.scene.replaceAllElements(elements, { replaceAllPages: Boolean((appState && "pages" in appState) || elements.some((el) => el.pageId && el.pageId !== this.scene.getActivePageId())) }); in applyDeltas, initialize nextElements from this.scene.getAllElementsMapIncludingDeleted().
7. In loadFileToCanvas, read const elements = this.scene.getAllElementsIncludingDeleted(); before calling loadSceneOrLibraryFromBlob.

sites.rule: Return this.scene.getAllElementsIncludingDeleted() and this.scene.getAllElementsMapIncludingDeleted().

Sync activePageId on this.scene and this.history when actionResult.appState?.activePageId is a string, and pass { replaceAllPages: Boolean(actionResult.replaceAllPages || actionResult.replaceFiles || (actionResult.appState && "pages" in actionResult.appState)) } to this.scene.replaceAllElements.
Reset scene and history activePageId to defaultAppState.activePageId and call this.scene.replaceAllElements([], { replaceAllPages: true }).
Restore restoredAppState first and pass validPageIds and defaultPageId from restoredAppState.pages to restoreElements.

Pass this.scene.getAllElementsMapIncludingDeleted() to this.store.commit and this.scene.getAllElementsIncludingDeleted() to this.props.onChange and this.onChangeEmitter.trigger without mutating pages in componentDidUpdate.
Sync scene and history activePageId when appState.activePageId is passed to updateScene, and pass replaceAllPages when pages or cross-page elements are passed.
Initialize nextElements from this.scene.getAllElementsMapIncludingDeleted() in applyDeltas.
Read const elements = this.scene.getAllElementsIncludingDeleted(); in loadFileToCanvas.

behaviour: Export restore and ExcalidrawPage from the @excalidraw/excalidraw package entrypoint.
rules: 1. Add restore to the value exports from ./data/restore.
2. Add ExcalidrawPage to the type exports from ./types.

params.name: opts
params.type: { refreshDimensions?: boolean; repairBindings?: boolean; deleteInvisibleElements?: boolean } | undefined

Export ExcalidrawPage type from ./types.
